fields.title: SSC CHSL Syllabus 2026
fields.description: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language and General Awareness.

fields.title: SSC CGL 2026 Syllabus
fields.description:
SSC CGL 2026 – Tier-I Syllabus

1. General Intelligence and Reasoning
- Analogies
- Classification
- Series
- Coding and Decoding
- Venn Diagrams
- Space Visualization
- Problem Solving
- Decision Making
- Blood Relations
- Syllogism
- Statement and Conclusion
- Non-Verbal Reasoning
- Figure Classification
- Embedded Figures
- Mirror Images
- Paper Folding
- Number Series

2. General Awareness
- Current Affairs
- History
- Geography
- Indian Polity
- Indian Economy
- General Science
- Scientific Research
- India and its neighbouring countries
- Culture
- Sports

3. Quantitative Aptitude
- Number System
- Percentage
- Ratio and Proportion
- Average
- Profit and Loss
- Simple Interest
- Compound Interest
- Time and Work
- Time and Distance
- Algebra
- Geometry
- Mensuration
- Trigonometry
- Data Interpretation

4. English Comprehension
- Vocabulary
- Grammar
- Sentence Structure
- Synonyms
- Antonyms
- Spelling
- Error Detection
- Fill in the Blanks
- Idioms and Phrases
- One Word Substitution
- Reading Comprehension
- Cloze Test
- Sentence Improvement
- Active and Passive Voice
- Direct and Indirect Speech


SSC CGL 2026 – Tier-II Syllabus

Paper-I:
- Mathematical Abilities
- Reasoning and General Intelligence
- English Language and Comprehension
- General Awareness
- Computer Knowledge Test
- Data Entry Speed Test

Paper-II:
- Statistics

Paper-III:
- General Studies (Finance and Economics)
